comment: Minimal trusted-configuration additions after a human review approves a new object type <Type> (NX-044/NX-050). Not applied automatically: the scheduler adds them to a new deploy/authorization/service-grants manifest version; the owner records the restricted groups. Generated per tenant by: python -m nexloop_eios.review_actions type-coverage --manifest deploy/authorization/service-grants.v1.json --tenant <tenant> --database-url-file <configurator DSN file> --owner-restrictions deploy/authorization/owner-property-restrictions.json

grants.purpose: Recall and match Claims on the review-approved type.
Reflow creation of review-approved instances; successors published by later reviews are followed.
Governed writes of matched values on the type; successors followed.

property_access_rules.purpose: Per-object READ/EDIT derived from the type rule (0084); every property of a review-approved type arrives through review.

service_grants.message_read_rules: unchanged: the v5 claim_matching rule already covers the evidence Messages of any Claim still to be matched, whatever its type
